evidence: Traupman 21: abhinc vīgintī annōs, twenty years ago

phrases.latin: abhinc plūs mīlle annōs in summō monte castellum aedificāvērunt
phrases.english: more than a thousand years ago they built a castle on the top of the mountain
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

phrases.english: We went to see Grandpa a week ago.

phrases.latin: intereā mulier quaedam abhinc triennium ex Andrō commigrāvit hūc vīcīniae
phrases.english: meanwhile, three years ago, a certain woman moved here from Andros, into the neighbourhood

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 21, 86.
